facts.fact: RSF reports that on 15 July 2026 journalist and columnist Haythem El Mekki was sentenced to one year in prison over a post denouncing conditions in a hospital morgue.
RSF says that in 2024 over ten journalists in Tunisia were targeted by legal proceedings for doing their jobs, among them Mourad Zeghidi, held since 11 May 2024.
RSF says the radio station Diwan FM keeps a balanced, critical approach to the political news cycle; no named policy is given and no date, so the document's publication date 2026-04-30 is used.

RSF says the National Union of Tunisian Journalists (SNJT) protested the presidential palace no longer receiving journalists since 2019; no date for the protest is given, so the publication date 2026-04-30 is used.

note: Convictions of Zied El Heni and Khaoula Boukrim are named only in a headline, and Zeghidi's detention gives no statement: no fact.
